text:
anna_ml: heads up — on yuna-v1 quant q4f we’re seeing a pretty big zh->en BLEU drop in the latest bring-up. reproducible on staging. :grimacing:

yusuke: ugh, saw the CI alert earlier from eval-bot. any sample failure?

anna_ml: repro attached below. quick metrics: baseline fp16 zh->en BLEU=28.5, q4f run BLEU=22.1 (delta -6.4). embedding cosine on parallel pairs dropped 0.88 -> 0.74. chrF also down.

li_cheng: can you paste the exact eval command you used?

anna_ml: sure:
```
# repro command
python tools/eval.py --model yuna-v1 --quant=q4f --langs zh,en,ja,he --split=newstest --batch=128 --embeddings --output=tmp/q4f-run.json
```

anna_ml: weird tokenization artifact observed on some CJK examples — punctuation/comma tokens merging into previous han/kanji chunks. eg input: "今天、测试。"

anna_ml: tokenized -> ["今天、测试", "。"] but expected -> ["今天", "、", "测试", "。"]

julia_prod: that token merge would shift alignment and hurt BLEU a lot. is this a tokenizer change or post-quant suffix handling?

eval-bot: automated note: regression signature matches locale-token-boundary pattern, similarity=0.87 with known CJK-punct-merge cases.

yusuke: did you change tokenizer assets in the packaging step? q4f should not touch byte-level tokenization. maybe kernel ordering changed and we’re falling back to a legacy tokenization table at runtime.

anna_ml: packaging diffs show new wheel includes tokenizer v1.3.4 -> v1.4.0. but onboarding notes said tokenizer unchanged. suspicious.

mike_infra: I’ll pull the deploy logs for the canary nodes. if kernel selection flagged an incompatible kernel we might be using fallback tokenization binary. give me 10m.

li_cheng: aside from token merge, Hebrew/RTL samples show bracket mirroring flipped in q4f outputs — eg expected "שלום (hello)" but model emits closing paren before Hebrew text in some decodes. not consistent but correlated with quant run.

julia_prod: rtl bracket flipping + punctuation merge = strong indicator something in the BPE/regex normalizer changed or decoding char order is being fed wrong lengths. Could also be kv-cache alignment off for bidi scripts.

yusuke: plan: 1) bisect packaging -> tokenizer asset diff (I can take this). 2) reproduce with CPU fallback (no kernel selection) to rule out runtime fallback. 3) run q8x2 / int8 smoke to see quant-sensitivity.

anna_ml: I started a small bisect: git bisect log pinned to wheel build — first suspect commit is 1f4c9b8 (tokenizer: normalize_fullwidth_punct).

yusuke: nice find. please add a tiny repro that shows the token boundary mapping (input -> tokens) before and after. puts pressure on the tokenizer owners.

li_cheng: i’ll run int8 and q8x2 on dedicated nodes and post side-by-side diffs of tokenization + BLEU. ETA 2h.

mike_infra: logs: canary nodes did log a kernel fallback at 2026-03-21T10:12:03Z (kernel_id=hk_legacy_token_v0). pushing the full stderr now.

mike_infra: ```
[2026-03-21T10:12:03Z] kernel selection: requested q4f_kernel v2 -> incompatible, falling back to hk_legacy_token_v0
[2026-03-21T10:12:04Z] loaded tokenizer_binary /opt/tokens/hk_legacy_token_v0.bin
```

anna_ml: that matches. hk_legacy_token_v0 has different punctuation split rules. we need to ensure packaging includes the new tokenizer binary and that runtime prefers it.

julia_prod: short-term mitigation: pin routing for EastAsia locale to fp16/dedicated which uses the correct tokenization binary. longer-term: fix kernel selector priority and add a regression test for fullwidth punctuation token boundaries.

yusuke: I assigned the bisect to myself and will open a PR to force tokenizer asset compatibility check in the deploy pipeline. tagging @tokenizer-team in the PR description.

anna_ml: added sample failing pairs to the repro set (attached to the ticket). also included a minimal decode snippet to reproduce locally:
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizers/yuna_v1.json')
print(t.encode('今天、测试。').tokens)
```

li_cheng: posted q8x2 run results: BLEU=27.6 (only -0.9 from fp16), tokens look correct. so q4f path seems to trigger the legacy asset fallback.

eval-bot: triage summary: probable cause = kernel selection fallback -> legacy tokenizer binary. impact = zh/en BLEU drop -6.4 on q4f; rtl bracket mirroring in sampled he cases. Severity: P2.

anna_ml: next steps: yusuke to PR kernel selector fix, mike to patch deploy to validate tokenizer assets, li to run expanded eval on multi-split after fix. I’ll hold on rolling yuna-v1 q4f until green. :white_check_mark:

yusuke: on it. will update thread when bisect completes.

mike_infra: deploy patch staged to canary, including asset checksum validation. kicking off canary re-run now.

li_cheng: thanks everyone — cc @product-ml so they know we’re blocking q4f launch until this is sorted.

anna_ml: thanks, great collaboration.
